title: Superstep overview
description: Server, database, queue, runs, models and product health from the Superstep OTel metrics (STUDIO_OTEL_METRICS=1).

panels.title: Redis
panels.description: No value when REDIS_URL is not set.

panels.title: App connection pool
panels.description: SQLAlchemy pool of every API and worker process (STUDIO_OTEL_METRICS=1).

panels.title: Postgres connections
panels.description: Collector postgresql and sqlquery receivers with the monitoring role; empty until POSTGRES_MONITOR_PASSWORD is set.

panels.title: Redis memory
panels.description: Collector redis receiver; no data when Redis is not configured. maxmemory shows only when it is set.

panels.title: In-memory run bus
panels.description: 1 when a process runs without REDIS_URL; production should use Redis.

panels.title: Estimated cost (24 h)
panels.description: Priced runs only; see the unpriced calls next to it.

panels.title: Unpriced model calls (24 h)
panels.description: Calls to models with no price; add them with STUDIO_PRICES.

panels.title: Model call latency by provider (p95)
panels.description: Each provider call on its own, fallback attempts included; mock calls are not measured.

panels.title: Time to first token by provider (p95)
Embedding tokens by source
panels.description: ingest: documents added or re-indexed; query: searches, Retriever nodes and knowledge tools.

panels.title: Channel messages
panels.description: Approval requests and chat replies (out), button presses and chat trigger messages (in).

panels.title: Throttling
panels.description: Requests refused by a product limit, by scope, next to model provider rate limits.

panels.title: Stopped schedules
panels.description: Turned off by the scheduler after failures; see Settings → Usage for the reason.
